activity.notes: GOV.UK records Neville Chamberlain as Prime Minister from 1937 to 1940. ATLAS deliberately stores the source-supported year granularity here rather than relying on an unverified deep-link for day precision; it records the premiership itself, not his lifespan or broader ministerial career.

sources.title: History of Neville Chamberlain
sources.citation_text: GOV.UK identifies Neville Chamberlain as Conservative Prime Minister with dates in office 1937 to 1940, and states that he succeeded Baldwin in May 1937 and resigned in May 1940.
